_meta.notes: Main-menu and in-game shop. The catalogue is the six items the game already defines (config/items.json), so nothing is sold that the inventory cannot hold. Prices are in spores (config/spores.json), the earned currency: the server checks the balance, grants the item into the pouch and answers with a fresh INVENTORY_SYNC. Biomass is the plant's growth budget, not money; quoting prices in it made a purchase either starve the plant or change nothing.

shop_enabled.notes: Show the Shop button on the title screen and in game. Off hides the entry points and refuses to open the panel.

shop_title.notes: Panel heading. RULE_13: a noun, never a slogan.

shop_currency_name.notes: What a price is paid in. Spores are earned (dung, mutations, kill credit) and shown by the HUD chip and the shop's own balance row.

items.name: Starter Fertilizer
items.description: Feeds the plant and enriches the soil under its crown.

items.name: Starter Dung
items.description: Water still in it. Feeds the plant and the soil under its root.

items.name: Growth Essence
items.description: Bottled growth energy, drunk straight from the pouch.

items.name: Basic Heirloom Seed
items.description: A seed from a plant that was kept. Not usable yet.

items.name: Offspring Seed
items.description: A seed from a plant that grew a seed of its own. Not usable yet.

items.name: Basic Gene Booster
items.description: A tuned gene compound for the booster system. Not usable yet.

shop_sections.notes: Sections in display order. Each entry is { id, label, items: [{ id, name, description, price, icon }] }. Item ids are the ids in config/items.json: a shop entry that names an item the inventory cannot hold is a promise the game cannot keep.
